rows.name: add_cancellation_fee_ledger_and_bill_fields
statements:
alter table public.srk_booking_workers
  add column if not exists on_the_way_at timestamptz,
  add column if not exists arrived_at timestamptz;
alter table public.service_bookings
  add column if not exists pending_cancellation_fee_amount numeric(12,2) not null default 0
    check (pending_cancellation_fee_amount>=0);
alter table public.srk_booking_final_bills
  add column if not exists cancellation_fee_amount numeric(12,2) not null default 0
    check (cancellation_fee_amount>=0);

alter table public.srk_booking_final_bill_items
  drop constraint if exists srk_booking_final_bill_items_item_type_check;
alter table public.srk_booking_final_bill_items
  add constraint srk_booking_final_bill_items_item_type_check
  check (item_type in ('service','labour','material','discount','other','cancellation_fee'));

create table if not exists public.srk_booking_cancellation_fees (
 id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
 cancelled_booking_id uuid not null unique references public.service_bookings(id) on delete restrict,
 customer_user_id uuid not null,
 fee_amount numeric(12,2) not null check (fee_amount>0),
 fee_basis text not null check (fee_basis in ('technician_on_the_way','technician_arrived')),
 status text not null default 'pending'
   check (status in ('pending','added_to_next_booking','paid','waived','under_review')),
 next_booking_id uuid references public.service_bookings(id) on delete restrict,
 created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
 added_to_next_booking_at timestamptz,
 paid_at timestamptz,
 waived_by uuid,
 waiver_reason text
);
create index if not exists srk_booking_cancellation_fees_customer_status_idx
 on public.srk_booking_cancellation_fees(customer_user_id,status,created_at);
create index if not exists srk_booking_cancellation_fees_next_booking_idx
 on public.srk_booking_cancellation_fees(next_booking_id);
alter table public.srk_booking_cancellation_fees enable row level security;

create or replace function public.srk_set_final_bill_total()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
set search_path to 'pg_catalog','public'
as $function$
begin
 new.total_amount:=round(new.service_amount+new.materials_amount
   +coalesce(new.cancellation_fee_amount,0)-new.discount_amount+new.tax_amount,2);
 return new;
end
$function$;

create or replace function public.srk_customer_list_cancellation_fees()
returns setof public.srk_booking_cancellation_fees
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path to 'pg_catalog','public','auth'
as $function$
 select f.* from public.srk_booking_cancellation_fees f
 where f.customer_user_id=auth.uid()
 order by f.created_at desc
$function$;
revoke all on function public.srk_customer_list_cancellation_fees() from public,anon;
grant execute on function public.srk_customer_list_cancellation_fees() to authenticated;

rows.name: revoke_direct_client_grants_on_rls_tables_without_policies
statements:
do $migration$
declare r record;
begin
 for r in
   select n.nspname,c.relname
   from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
   where n.nspname in ('public','private','srk_private')
     and c.relkind='r' and c.relrowsecurity
     and not exists(
       select 1 from pg_policies p
       where p.schemaname=n.nspname and p.tablename=c.relname
     )
 loop
   execute format('revoke all privileges on table %I.%I from anon, authenticated',r.nspname,r.relname);
 end loop;
end
$migration$;

create or replace function public.srk_customer_preview_booking_price_v2(
 p_category_id uuid,p_service_type_id uuid,p_skill_id uuid,p_skill_level_id uuid,
 p_technician_count integer,p_helper_count integer,p_duration_hours integer,
 p_motor_hp numeric default null,p_unit_count integer default 1
)
returns table(
 pricing_unit text,qualification_level text,
 technician_rate numeric,helper_rate numeric,
 estimated_base_total numeric,estimated_company_commission numeric,
 estimated_worker_net numeric,overtime_may_apply boolean,
 materials_included boolean,price_note text,
 pending_cancellation_fee_amount numeric,estimated_customer_total numeric
)
language sql
security definer
set search_path to 'pg_catalog','public','auth'
as $function$
 select p.pricing_unit,p.qualification_level,p.technician_rate,p.helper_rate,
   p.estimated_base_total,p.estimated_company_commission,p.estimated_worker_net,
   p.overtime_may_apply,p.materials_included,p.price_note,
   coalesce(f.pending_fee,0)::numeric,
   round(p.estimated_base_total+coalesce(f.pending_fee,0),2)
 from public.srk_customer_preview_booking_price(
   p_category_id,p_service_type_id,p_skill_id,p_skill_level_id,
   p_technician_count,p_helper_count,p_duration_hours,p_motor_hp,p_unit_count
 ) p
 cross join lateral (
   select sum(cf.fee_amount) pending_fee
   from public.srk_booking_cancellation_fees cf
   where cf.customer_user_id=auth.uid() and cf.status='pending'
 ) f
$function$;
revoke all on function public.srk_customer_preview_booking_price_v2(uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid,integer,integer,integer,numeric,integer) from public,anon;
grant execute on function public.srk_customer_preview_booking_price_v2(uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid,integer,integer,integer,numeric,integer) to authenticated;
